annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/1199 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 as regards harmonised standards for lifts with inclined travel path and correcting that Decision as regards harmonised standards for steel wire ropes
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/1199 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 as regards harmonised standards for lifts with inclined travel path and correcting that Decision as regards harmonised standards for steel wire ropes
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision of 11 July 2022 amending Decision 2021/76 on harmonised standards under the Lifts Directive 2014/33/EU. It adds EN 81-22:2021 for inclined lifts, defers withdrawal of EN 81-22:2014, and deletes steel wire rope standards that cannot confer presumption of conformity. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds EN 81-22:2021 (inclined-travel-path lifts) as entry 3a in Annex I of Decision 2021/76
Deletes EN 81-22:2014 from Annex I, applying from 12 January 2024
Corrects Decision 2021/76 by deleting steel wire rope standards (entries 13, 14, 16)
Compliance with listed standards gives presumption of conformity under Directive 2014/33/EU
Enters into force on the day of publication
